decision.completed: Two previously unused full official test meetings, four physical-channel native journals, prediction-only six-window selection, fixed same-recognizer rawdualGSS-vs-mono controls, all people and raw generations scored. Source lossless FLAC SHA verified before streaming PCM16 decode.

interpretation: The second physical input is evaluated without downmix or codec loss; gains/failures therefore cannot be explained away by a missing decompression step.

Both full journals include all reference participants, but short interjections remain missed; small-room false activity and medium-room misses need distinct correction, not one globally lower threshold.
Independent per-mic DER does not show a consistent second-mic improvement; no two-way DOVER-Lap fusion or reference-chosen microphone is used.
Rawdual and mono controls share predicted waveform gates. Better aggregate edits do not excuse a participant omission or qualify a complete recording.
Two ordinary30s controls preserve original PCM/text through bypass; this does not establish full ordinaryCER<5%.
Public eight-mic-array channels0/1 are not the current close-spaced card capture geometry.
Previously unused by this project does not prove absence from public-model pretraining. These exposed development meetings are no longer a final blind test.
decision.next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP：停止把“更准分人→固定双路GSS→ASR”当作完整修复，保留其空间辅助价值和本轮全自动基线。下一项是从已可复现的开源目标说话人提取骨干准备单一“说话人身份/活动+双路空间线索”联合前端，训练数据仅用真实训练会议及目标缺席负样本，独立会议验证，先固定协议再运行；评价逐人文字保留、非目标串话和普通讲话回退，不只看声纹/MOS。先验证一个联合方案再决定是否扩大微调，不扫模型/参数、不把官方活动辅助结果算成绩。保留原严格<5%、纪要事实、双端实卡和售卖OPEN。

oracleActivityDiagnostic.hypothesis: Fixing activity/identity alone is sufficient only if the fixed separator substantially recovers the missing target words without residual severe leakage. This is causal diagnosis on exposed clips, not an attainable accuracy guarantee.
oracleActivityDiagnostic.timeScope: The observer-error attempt exited before publishing a per-stage result; its separate wall duration is retained instead of silently counting it as zero. Unique completed GSS receipts do not count interrupted/recomputed algorithm calls.
oracleActivityDiagnostic.conclusion: True reference activity/identity does not solve this fixed separation+ASR combination:237/698 diagnostic edits remain, medium-room105automatic→121oracle worsens while small-room256→116 improves. This is not a pure separator upper bound or a directly attainable product accuracy. The control also shows some participant deletion regressions versus its matching oracle-mono control. Do not propose diarization-only repair as sufficient.

largestFullyInteriorOmission.note: Other active voices may be real overlap as well as wrong identity; this audit proves target absence on both channels, not that every other active slot is a label swap.

proof.reason: Previous controller interruption after WAV close before receipt publication. Exact frozen original PCM and activity mask reproduce every sample.

purpose.hypothesis: If true activity/identity still leaves substantial speaker words missing or contaminated, fixing diarization alone is insufficient; spatial front end also needs a different separation design. If much improved, prioritize robust identity/activity before more separator models.

review.metric: Fixed full-meeting-identity-mapped character edit counts on prediction-selected30s windows; whole midpoint-selected reference utterances, straddling boundaries disclosed. Not strict full-meetingCER or pure-overlapCER.
